text:
kai: quick note from the prefill smoke: a few prefixes were briefly visible on two nodes after a handoff. not a full failure but dangerous.

maria: yeah saw that. looks like transfer ack before durable epoch write on recipient. double-evict risk.

jon: proposal: cheap 2-phase handoff: Prepare (write intent + return token) then Commit (persist epoch + finalize). keeps origin holding until commit.

ravi: agree, but watch metadata bloat if many prepares stack up. add TTL and per-tenant caps.

kai: rollout plan? gate by feature flag on canaries, metric prepare_pending and prepare_timeouts.

maria: also add GET /residency_debug for ops to inspect pending tokens for a prefix. we'll add prepare_timeouts_total and double_evict_prevented_count.

jon: optimization: fast-path single RPC when cross-host latency is low; otherwise 2-phase. TransferHint header.

ravi: tests: simulate kill between Prepare and Commit; ensure origin keeps lease. i'll add chaos test.

kai: owners: maria RFC + proto, ravi tests, jon canary rollout. i'll hold on expanding rollout until metrics look clean.

maria: i'll draft the proto and include curl snippets for manual tests.

jon: thanks, let's sync later this week.
